External links for this lesson. Every link below was checked with `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200) and the page title confirmed (the one exception is noted). The regulation text quoted in the lesson comes from this repo's `sources/` copies; the Cornell links are verified-loading mirrors for checking current text. Video: [CLIA Proficiency Testing (PT) Final Rule, CMS-3355-F](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7qKGYH6w3Nw) (CDC, YouTube) is embedded in the lesson. It covers PT generally, not referral or LIS design. Title checked against YouTube's oEmbed record on 2026-11-13.

- **[Cornell LII: 42 CFR 493.801, Condition: Enrollment and testing of samples](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/42/493.801)** — the PT condition, including (b)(4) communications, (b)(5) referral and (b)(6) records. Use it to re-check current wording before quoting. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[Cornell LII: 42 CFR 493.61, Requirements for a certificate of accreditation](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/42/493.61)** — (b)(1), the accredited lab's same-manner duty. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[Cornell LII: 42 CFR 493.1236, Standard: Evaluation of proficiency testing performance](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/42/493.1236)** — review, evaluation and documentation of PT. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[Cornell LII: 42 CFR 493.1251, Standard: Procedure manual](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/42/493.1251)** — what goes in the manual and the laboratory director's approval of changes. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[Cornell LII: 42 CFR 493.1804, General considerations](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/42/493.1804)** — the sanctions provision that 493.801(b)(5) points to for improper referrals. Not in this repo's `sources/`, so the lesson does not describe it; read it here. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 606.160, Records](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.160)** — FDA's blood-establishment records rule, where (b)(5)(v) lists proficiency test results. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[CMS: Proficiency Testing Program Requirements: General & Cytology](https://cms.gov/medicare/quality/clinical-laboratory-improvement-amendments/proficiency-testing)** — CMS's own PT program page. Use it for current CMS PT materials. I confirmed the page loads and its title; I did not review everything on it. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[CAP: Proficiency Testing/External Quality Assessment Frequently Asked Questions](https://cap.org/laboratory-improvement/proficiency-testing/proficiency-testing-pt-external-quality-assessment-eqa-faq)** — the accreditor's public PT FAQ. Public page only; CAP checklist text is not quoted in this course. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

Earlier modules this lesson builds on: [Where CLIA and CAP Reach a Blood Center](../where-clia-and-cap-reach-a-blood-center/index.qmd), [The LIS and the Test Report](../the-lis-and-the-test-report/index.qmd), [Collection and testing](../../blood-center-operations/collection-and-testing/index.qmd), [Multi-Site Governance and Donor Identification](../../data-integrity-and-records/multi-site-governance-and-donor-identification/index.qmd), [Risk-Based Testing and Regression](../../release-management-and-sdlc/risk-based-testing-and-regression/index.qmd).

## Keep learning

Not official sources, and not authority for any regulatory claim. I confirmed each page loads, and read only enough of each to confirm its subject, so check any detail against the current regulation and your lab's own CAP checklist.

- **[New Rules for Proficiency Testing Referral](https://myadlm.org/cln/articles/2014/august/new-rules-for-proficiency-testing-referral)** (ADLM's Clinical Laboratory News, a professional association's publication) — a practitioner explanation of how CMS separates intentional from other PT referrals. It was written when the rule changed, so use it for the reasoning and check the current text above. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; title "New Rules for Proficiency Testing Referral | myadlm.org").
- **[PT referral raising red flags with CMS](https://www.captodayonline.com/Archives/cover_stories/0308_PTreferral.html)** (CAP TODAY, a CAP publication; archive article) — an older piece showing how PT referral problems arise in practice. It predates the current text, so treat it as background. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; the page heading is "PT referral raising red flags with CMS"; no `<title>` tag was returned).
- **[LabCE: Proficiency Testing (PT) Introduction](https://labce.com/spg1730334_proficiency_testing_pt_introduction.aspx)** (LabCE, a commercial continuing-education vendor) — an introductory course page for laboratory staff. Vendor content.
